reviews.x: These are much cheaper on the NYX website or at Ulta!!! But these are amazing lipsticks❤️

reviews.t: Cute but a lot of work
reviews.x: Love the color but hate the fact that I have to apply it so many times to stay on!! I can't eat or drink when wearing this color because it easily comes off and since my skin is so light, the fading is definitely noticeable. Product feels nice on the lips though, and is definitely edgey and fun.

This colour is so beautiful ! I was looking for something similar to Anastasia Beverly hills lipsticks (can't spend $30 on a lipstick). This was sold for cheaper. It looks a lot like Vamp from ABH. It's a gorgeous matte colour. It has become one of my favorite !

Maybe i just got a bad product. There were so many hood reviews, i was so excited to try this lip color. The first thing i found is that the color does not match the photo. What looks like red wine in thr image is more of a brown. The color is still rich and very beautiful, but does not match the photo. Ultimately the beautiful color is the only reason im giving this more than one star. When i actually applied the lipstick it started out creamy and lovely, but as it started to dry it became very

I ordered this lipstick in the color 'Vintage.' The color was as expected and very rich, however it doesn't dry as well as I hoped. It stays sticky for a long time. I had to reapply for touch ups after about two hours and a few beverages. The color was beautiful but I expected a little more out of the wear.

reviews.t: I absolutely loved this lipgloss/lipstick it applies like it is a lipgloss ...
reviews.x: I absolutely loved this lipgloss/lipstick it applies like it is a lipgloss then changes to a lipstick. It stays moisturized and I will be purchasing more.

reviews.t: A shade lighter than expected but still worth the buy!
reviews.x: To start off, most of my lipsticks are from NYX's suede collection. I was dying for a red since I had more of the bold colors.  Now, I expected this color to be darker but it's actually a bit lighter than the photo here suggests, I was a tinsy bit let down by that as I was hoping for a darker shade.  However, I love this product, it applies so nicely. You really only need 1 or 2 swipes to the lips. I'm out 7 hours a day as a highschool student. I snack about once and eat a full meal halfway thro
It's a nice texture lip applicant, but that color is not as pictured. It is super dark, coming out looking like black lip stick. I didn't like it. So, I give it one start based on color alone.
This is a great color, I am fair skinedcwith blue eyes and it looks great.
It came in very fast & I love the color

I really loved this color.  I would just recommend exfoliating your lips before using the product.  The color, of course, goes on darker depending on how many layers you apply.  One layer makes it a deep red, the more layers you apply the more maroon it looks. I really loved the matte finish because it seemed to make the color stay on longer. Of course if you drink or eat, you'll need to reapply.

reviews.t: so it feels like it will bleed easily
reviews.x: The color is BOMB. The quality is so-so.  I feel as if this lipstick never really drys, so it feels like it will bleed easily.  It definitely needs quite a few reapplications throughout the day if you plan on wearing it all day. Also, you need quite a few coats to get a good, solid color on your lips.

reviews.t: I love NYX, and I have other liquid suede colors ...
reviews.x: I love NYX, and I have other liquid suede colors that I love, but Vintage is just...not what I expected. It turned out lighter than I expected, and I had to apply 3 coats to get it to an even color. It stayed on okay and it at least didn't make my lips feel dry.

I order Suede. .. and I love this color... is matte and it does not dried my lips at all... lips feel fresh and at the same time matte!!!! Will for sure order again!!!! I wish I could submit a photo but I don't know how to do it...

reviews.t: Say no to this awful vino color
reviews.x: Overpriced on here and the color was an unflattering burnt flat berry. By flat I mean no depth and it seemed to crack easier than the other color I purchased from this collection.
The coulour shown on the Product, is tottaly different than the one in reality! Very disapointed!

reviews.t: Was not too happy about this product
reviews.x: You get what you pay for I guess. Was not too happy about this product. But I'm still a NYC fan😄
I'll be buying more of this soon, cause it's my favorite color to wear.

reviews.t: it's a very pretty brown and when mixed with "kitten heels" it gives ...
reviews.x: I ordered "vintage" hoping for a burgundy or dark red, and I got a warm toned light brown. I've heard of this happening to other people as well. It doesn't bother me too much, it's a very pretty brown and when mixed with "kitten heels" it gives me the dark red/burgundy I was looking for. Application is a little streaky, so layering is best. It's not inconvenient for me, but might sway other people wanting to purchase this liquid lipstick.

reviews.t: Love it! Cant find it locally anymore.
reviews.x: Amazing this liquid cream matt lipstick is my favoite! I struggled a bit with it at first. Although it stayed on for several hours no problem. It always lookded as if my lips were very dry and you could see the crecess in my lips instead of the smooth matt look. But one day I put chapstick on underneath first. And it was perfect still long lasting matt look. But also smooth. I hope this helps ladies. Its a brilliant deep red on my coco brown skin.

I got this product since I liked the color. I expected it to be like a normal lip gloss/lip stick and need reapplied dozens of times. The color was amazing and better then I expected and the wear of this lipstick is outstanding. Once it dries it lasts quite a while. It will need retouched after eating and drinking but I was very pleased and will def be getting more Nyx lip products in the future

reviews.t: I love this Nyx Liquid suede
reviews.x: I love this Nyx Liquid suede! It comes in a wide range of colors, which are all beautiful! It definitely dries matte and is beautiful after the application of it. It is very drying to the lips though and it starts to come off in little chunks, that's the reason for the four stars instead of five. Very beautiful for the price and after a few reapplications during the day it is gorgeous!

reviews.t: It comes off super quick. The color is beautiful but super disappointed ...
reviews.x: If you are looking for a lipstick that you can wear for a few minutes then you will want this one. I was extremely frustrated with this product. They claim it is waterproof but it is no where near that. It comes off super quick. The color is beautiful but super disappointed in the formula. I will not be purchasing this again.

I bought this product after much thought and after carefully considering the reviews!  I have only worn the this product once thus far and I am  satisfied with the matte look (when compared to MAC which requires frequent application - at least for me) and I would definitely purchase more in the future!

My daughter turned me on to this.  She was wearing it and asked me to try it.  I use to wear dark lipstick all the time, however I changed last year to lighter colors.  This was the exception.  It stayed on looked great and my boyfriend who doesn't really like makeup even said it looked really good.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the color, calling it gorgeous, rich, and beautiful.
Several reviewers say the color does not match the product photo, appearing darker, lighter, or browner than expected.
A common complaint is that the lipstick requires multiple reapplications or coats to maintain color.
Some reviewers note the product stays sticky or tacky and doesn't fully dry.
Some reviewers mention the product is cheaper elsewhere or overpriced here.
